views.label: Four dimensions
legend: the apparent horizon, $r = \ell$ after the shell
caption: The Kretschmann scalar $K$ of a thin shell of light falling into anti-de Sitter space of four dimensions, over the plane of $v$ and $r$. It is $24/\ell^4$ before the shell and $24/\ell^4 + 48G^2M^2/c^4r^6$ after it.
views.input: A thin shell of light of mass $M$ falling in along $v = 0$, with $m(v) = \tfrac{1}{2}M(1 + \tanh(v/v_0))$, $2GM/c^2 = 2\ell$, and $cv_0 = \ell/100$.

views.label: Flat front
legend: the apparent horizon, $r = \ell$ after the shell
caption: The Kretschmann scalar $K$ of a thin shell of light with a flat front, over the plane of $v$ and $r$. It is $24/\ell^4$ before the shell and $24/\ell^4 + 12\ell^2/r^6$ after it.
views.input: A thin shell of light falling in along $v = 0$, with $m(v) = \tfrac{1}{2}\ell(1 + \tanh(v/v_0))$ and $cv_0 = \ell/100$.

views.label: Poincaré, four dimensions
legend: the apparent horizon, $z = \ell$ after the shell
caption: The Kretschmann scalar $K$ of a thin shell of light with a flat front, over the plane of $v$ and $z$. It is $24/\ell^4$ before the shell and $24/\ell^4 + 12z^6/\ell^{10}$ after it.
views.input: A thin shell of light falling in along $v = 0$, with $m(v) = (1 + \tanh(v/v_0))/2\ell^3$ and $cv_0 = \ell/100$.

views.label: Five dimensions
legend: the apparent horizon, $r = \ell$ after the shell
caption: The Kretschmann scalar $K$ of a thin shell of light falling into anti-de Sitter space of five dimensions, over the plane of $v$ and $r$. It is $40/\ell^4$ before the shell and $40/\ell^4 + 288\ell^4/r^8$ after it.
views.input: A thin shell of light falling in along $v = 0$, with $m(v) = \ell^2(1 + \tanh(v/v_0))$ and $cv_0 = \ell/100$.
